regulator_name: Florida Construction Industry Licensing Board (DBPR CILB)

records.title: Florida Certified General Contractor (CGC): selected examination-route steps
records.overview: Selected regulator-sourced qualification and licensing steps for Florida Certified General Contractors (CGC). Florida Statutes § 489.111 establishes alternative experience-and-education matrices, three examination divisions, financial responsibility, and board review. Individual criminal background exceptions, business entity qualifications, and local permitting requirements are not fully covered. Always consult the DBPR directly. Learning App cannot issue a contractor license or determine legal eligibility.
records.review_note: Reviewed against the Florida DBPR Construction Industry Licensing Board (CILB) application center and CILB 5-A checklist on October 13, 2026. The board models experience/education combinations, 3-part examinations, credit verification, and board approval as distinct stages.

children.label: Document 4 years of active construction experience in the trade with at least 1 year as a foreman
children.condition: Experience must be verified by licensed general contractor references

children.label: Document 3 years of verified field experience plus 1 year of accredited college-level education
Document 2 years of verified field experience plus 2 years of accredited college construction education
Document 1 year of experience as a foreman plus 3 years of accredited college-level education
Graduate with a 4-year accredited degree in construction, architecture, or engineering plus 1 year as foreman
Qualify through verified military service construction experience evaluated by the Board
children.condition: Subject to CILB military equivalency review guidelines

children.label: Pass all three parts of the Florida state contractor exam: Business & Finance, Contract Admin, and Project Mgmt
children.condition: Passing score of 70% or higher required on each exam part

children.label: Demonstrate financial responsibility with a credit report showing a score of 660 or higher or approved bond
children.condition: Applicants below 660 must post a licensing bond and complete a 14-hour financial course

children.label: Obtain required public liability, property damage, and workers' compensation coverage or valid exemption
Complete electronic fingerprinting through a Florida Livescan service provider for background screening
Submit the completed DBPR CILB 5-A application form and required state processing fees
Receive the Certified General Contractor state license following Construction Industry Board review

records.title: Florida Certified Building Contractor (CBC): selected examination-route steps
records.overview: Selected regulator-sourced qualification and licensing steps for Florida Certified Building Contractors (CBC). Scope covers commercial and residential construction up to three stories. Statutory qualification alternatives include trade experience, college degrees, examinations, credit verification, and CILB board approval. Always consult the DBPR directly. Learning App cannot issue a contractor license or determine legal eligibility.
